key_reasoning.reason: Bounded ordered build runner (run_builds) in assistant_factory plus rewiring of LangGraphAssistantBuilder so custom and built-in subagent executors share one pool; shared state isolated across threads.

Thread-pool concurrency with contextvars copying, DB session (_current_session) isolation, fatal-error cancellation and ordering guarantees; latency/performance is the primary driver. No exact precedent in the codebase.
